title: Fix admin wallet UI to avoid misleading 0 PKR on query failure

requirements.summary: Prevent BalanceIndicator from showing a numeric 0 PKR for admins when admin wallet loading fails; show an English unavailable/error state, and keep admin wallet hidden for non-admins.
acceptanceCriteria: If getAdminWalletBalance errors for an authenticated admin user, BalanceIndicator does not render a numeric 0 as the admin wallet balance; it renders an English error/unavailable state.
If the viewer is not an admin, BalanceIndicator does not show an error state related to admin wallet access and simply omits the admin wallet portion.
If getAdminWalletBalance succeeds, BalanceIndicator shows the correct persisted admin wallet balance (formatted) and not 0.

file_operations.description: Adjust useGetAdminWalletBalance to surface fetch failures to the UI in a controlled way (no implicit 0/placeholder fallback for admin wallet), while keeping the query disabled for non-admins. This aligns with the app’s role-based access control from the authorization component (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).

Update admin wallet rendering to use the admin-wallet query error state: for admins, render a clear English unavailable/error message instead of formatting 0; keep the admin wallet section omitted for non-admin users. Ensure no user-facing non-English strings are introduced.

Extend error normalization (if needed) with a clear English message for admin-wallet-unavailable cases (including authorization traps and connectivity/actor availability) so BalanceIndicator can display a consistent, user-friendly status without showing 0.

requirements.summary: Update /admin wallet-balance card to show real admin wallet balance when available and a clear English unavailable/error state when not (never default to 0).
acceptanceCriteria: When signed in as an admin, /admin displays the same correct admin wallet balance as returned by getAdminWalletBalance.
When the admin wallet balance cannot be loaded, /admin shows an English error/unavailable state and does not show 0 as a fallback value.

file_operations.description: Update the admin wallet-balance card to: (1) show formatted balance only when the query has valid data, and (2) show a clear English unavailable/error message when the admin wallet cannot be loaded (including unauthorized), without rendering 0 as a fallback. Prefer using the shared normalizeBackendError helper for consistent messaging.

Ensure the /admin page’s useGetAdminWalletBalance consumption has the necessary query state (loading/error/data) to render the correct UI states without relying on BigInt(0) fallbacks. This should remain compatible with the authorization component’s admin gating behavior (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
